title: Work2Prevent Plus: Structural Intervention to Promote HIV Care in Black Sexual Minority Men
official: Work2Prevent Plus: Structural Intervention to Promote HIV Care in Black Sexual Minority Men
summary:
The goal of this observational study is to learn about the pilot test of the employment program among young men living with HIV or part of a community highly impacted by HIV.

The main question it aims to answer is: What is the feasibility and acceptability of the employment program?

Young male participants will attend the two day employment program and will complete four study surveys over the course of 6 months.

Employment program facilitators will complete a study survey and participate in a focus group over the course of 1 day.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Identifying as male
* Being ages 18-29 years old; AND
* EITHER living with HIV currently OR identifying with a population highly impacted by HIV (based on race/ethnicity or having ever had sex with another man) OR
* Being ages 18 or older
* Participated in facilitation or administrative support for the program, "The Work Shop," at a partnering community-based organization

Exclusion Criteria:

\- Participated in the preceding employment intervention, "Work2Prevent"
